note: Paths under benchmarks/results/ are run write targets; that directory is not tracked, so any predecessor artifact named here is unpublished history recorded for provenance, not a file in this repository.
purpose: Run the already-approved one-model Banking77 base-versus-fused lifecycle probe with the JSONL that current public Imp actually renders. This is a draft only: it does not authorize training, inference, or a server.

closed_predecessor.failure: The frozen JSONL receipts were produced by legacy DSEx.Adapter.Chat, while the launch runner used current Imp.Adapter.Chat.

change_control.only_v1_to_v2_change: Replace the stale legacy DSEx-rendered train/selection JSONL receipts and their derived row ordering with receipts precomputed from current Imp.Adapter.Chat.
unchanged: source-row selection and opaque route mapping
72/8 train/selection counts and deterministic split algorithm
model, revision, MLX-LM version, and local model bytes
accuracy, macro-F1, lifecycle, identity, reload, and cleanup checks

source_binding.launch_requirement: The adapter, dataset-builder, dataset-file, and model-tree digests must match this contract on an otherwise clean reviewed revision.

rendering_contract.system: Signature field declarations and structure, including the route Literal constraint and exact-match note, followed by the frozen routing instruction as the objective.
rendering_contract.user: The utterance remains in [[ ## utterance ## ]]; the response instruction requires route as a valid Python Literal and the completed marker.
rendering_contract.assistant: [[ ## route ## ]] followed by the opaque route value and a trailing [[ ## completed ## ]] marker.

dataset.task: Four-way opaque-route intent classification over natural Banking77 utterances.

evaluation.schedule: Start the pinned base server and evaluate the frozen selection and untouched test rows; train and fuse once through public MLXLMTrainer; rebind through TrainingJob.rebind; evaluate the same rows; save the exact job and program; reload and rebind in a fresh BEAM process; require byte-identical fresh fused test predictions; clean up every process and port.
evaluation.selection_use: Report only; no checkpoint, hyperparameter, threshold, or result selection is permitted.
evaluation.untouched_test_use: Base-versus-fused comparison and frozen lifecycle attribution only; never visible to training or selection.
lifecycle_acceptance: the content-inventoried fused artifact differs from the pinned base artifact
the runnable program is rebound to and advertises the exact fused artifact path and digest
at least one untouched-test prediction changes between base and fused
the saved job and program reproduce byte-identical fused test predictions in a fresh BEAM process
base and fused server identities match the exact artifacts they serve
every supervised process and reserved port is cleaned up

stop_rules: any source, adapter, dataset-builder, dataset-file, rendered-split, model-tree, or row-order receipt mismatch
any model, MLX-LM version, hyperparameter, generation setting, metric, or interpretation drift
first owning training, fusion, artifact, server, inference, reload, identity, or cleanup failure
any attempted retry, substitution, download expansion, or result-informed adjustment

interpretation.positive_or_negative_scores: Report exactly as observed on this one model, task, split, and seed.
interpretation.unchanged_predictions: Lifecycle attribution is incomplete, not proof that SFT is generally ineffective.
interpretation.failure: A stopped or incomplete run is a measurement/lifecycle failure, not an optimizer loss.
claim_limits: This draft does not authorize launch.
One run can establish the supported SFT artifact and fresh-consumer lifecycle plus task-specific changed behavior only.
It cannot establish general held-out effectiveness, DSPy or BetterTogether parity, GRPO, production reliability, or BEAM-native superiority.
V1 remains permanently stopped and must not be resumed, overwritten, or reinterpreted.
